key_concepts: Measurement involves a number and a unit
Mass is the amount of matter in an object
Gram, kilogram, and milligram are units of mass
Gram is the base unit of mass in the metric system
Kilo- means one thousand and milli- means one thousandth
Appropriate mass units are chosen for convenient expression
1 milligram equals one thousandth of a gram
Temperature is measured with a thermometer
Degrees Celsius, degrees Fahrenheit, and Kelvin are temperature units
Degree Celsius is a centigrade scale
The boiling point of water is 100 degrees Celsius
